Commentary.Commentary: That's all we have from this match. But don't go anywhere as the second match of the evening involving India and Bangladesh will kick off in a short while. Do join us in a short while at 1100 GMT (1900 local). Cheers!

Meg Lanning, the Australian captain, says that it is a sigh of relief as they manage to win this one. On losing early wickets, she replies that she knew that the target was a smaller one and hence they felt that they could take a few overs to settle. Mentions that their bowling was really good but admits that the fielding can get better. On the crowd coming to watch the game, Lanning thanks the supporters and finishes by saying that she is looking forward to the next few games.

Chamari Atapattu, the Sri Lankan captain, says that she tried to play her natural game and feels that if she had batted a few more overs, the total could've been different. On the total and defending the same, Atapattu tells that she was very confident about her bowlers but unfortunately it didn't go their way. Tells that when they took 3 early wickets, the side got pumped up but could not win the game.

RACHAEL HAYNES IS THE PLAYER OF THE MATCH! Says that it was much easier batting out there when she walked in and knowing that one of the best batters in the world is at the other end made her job easy. Constructing partnerships was the key and she feels that it's all about trusting your game. Mentions that by the time she got out to bat, the conditions had eased out and it was not swinging much.

Sri Lanka would be proud of their efforts! They pushed Australia to the brink and had they not dropped plenty of catches, this match could have gone in their favour. Still, there are many positives for them. The batting of their skipper has always been up to the mark but the way Nilakshi de Silva batted and Udeshika Prabodhani bowled with the new ball would have pleased them. Udeshika, in fact, used the conditions superbly and got the ball to move both ways.

Great recovery from 10/3 and Australia have managed to open their account in the tournament. After early hiccups, Meg Lanning and Rachael Haynes joined forces and threaded a match winning 95-run stand. Rachael, in particular, was brilliant in her approach and never bogged down under pressure. Her knock made sure that the asking rate never got out of hands and eventually Australia crossed the line with Meg batting through.
AUSTRALIA STAY ALIVE IN THE TOURNAMENT. Full and outside off, Perry gets across, leans and works it wide of long on. Comes back for the second and that is victory by 5 wickets.
Landed outside off, Perry waits for the ball to come and dabs it late past short third man for a couple.
DOT BALL. 4 needed from 5. Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Sugandika Kumari to bowl the final over.
Fullish and on middle, it's calmly pushed down to long on for a single. 4 needed off the last over.
Ellyse Perry arrives in the middle, finally.

OUT! Cleaned up! Atapattu has destroyed Carey's stumps. She sends across a flatter full ball in the line of the stumps, Carey tries whipping it across the line but misses. It goes behind to rattle the sticks.
Quicker and outside off, Meg pushes it out to covers for a run.
Play and a miss! Fuller in length outside off, Lanning tries to drive but misses.
Short and pulled to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller in length outside off, Meg is beaten on the drive.

FOUR! Down the ground. Tossed up ball around off, Carey comes down the track and whacks it over the bowler's head. The long on fielder fails to get around it. 10 runs and a wicket from the over, 8 more needed.
Flatter and outside off, played down to point for one.
FOUR! Strongly swept! Full and on middle, Lanning kneels and slog sweeps it in front of square leg for a cracking boundary. That's some response after getting a life.

DROPPED! Yet another chance shelled. You just cannot afford to keep dropping catches while defending a low total. Short in length and wide outside off, Lanning edges her attempted drive but the keeper Anushka fails to hold on.
Tossed up ball on off, Carey drives it through mid off for a run.
Nicola Carey is in next.

OUT! Stumped! Rachael runs out of luck but she has done her job efficiently. Siriwardene slows it up in the air and tempts the batter with flight. Haynes skips down the track and tries for a big shot but it lands and spins away to beat her bat. Anushka Sanjeewani does the rest. The 95-run stand has been broken but it's a little too late. Australia need to ensure that they don't lose two set batters like the last match. 18 needed off 17 balls.
Bowling change. Shashikala Siriwardene (3-0-10-1) is back into the attack

DROPPED AGAIN! Second life for Rachael as Kavisha Dilhari drops her in the deep. Atapattu serves a full toss on middle, Haynes dances down the track to clear long on but fails to pump over the fielder in the deep. Dilhari though drops a sitter. They cross for a run. 8 from the over.
A full toss outside off, Meg drives it square of the wicket on the off side for one.
Fullish and outside off, driven straight to covers.
FOUR! 100 up for Australia and they have recovered superbly from 10/3! Atapattu drops it short and on middle, her opposite number stays low and pulls it behind square leg for a boundary.
Too full in length on middle, Haynes walks forward and nearly yorks herself. Although she does well eventually to drive it through cover-point for a run.
Fullish and on middle, helped through mid-wicket for one.
SIX! Dismissed! This one is even better. 18 from the over. 26 needed more off 24 balls. Fuller length ball around middle, Haynes uses her feet again and sends it packing way over wide long on.

SIX! Up and over Harshitha Madavi! Flighted full ball on middle, Haynes skips down the track and heaves it over mid-wicket. Madavi at the edge of the rope tries to catch it over her head but it sails over. Fifty up for Rachael and she has played a gem!
Haynes runs down the track and forces it to wide long on for a couple of runs.
Two wides! Kumari delivers it way wide outside off, Lanning tries her best to cut but misses. The keeper also misses and they cross.
Quicker delivery, very full and outside off, Meg mistimes her attempted drive back towards the bowler off the bottom edge.
Kumari pulls out as she sees Lanning moving across her stumps.
Fullish and on the leg stump line, Rachael advances down the track and eases it to wide long on for one.
A full length delivery outside off, Lanning drives it through covers for a single.
Sugandika Kumari (2-0-16-0) returns to bowl.
Once again the Lankan skipper bowls it in the flatter trajectory. It's short and outside off, Meg pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 44 needed more off the last 5 overs.
Quicker through the air, flat and short outside off, Rachael slaps it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Lanning uses her feet this time. She takes it on the full and knocks it down to long on for a run.
Walks down the track and eases it through the gap at mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on off, Haynes gets back and defends.

FOUR! Rachael is putting on a show after early hiccups! Tossed up ball around middle, Haynes wears her skates and powers it over wide mid on. The fielder in the deep moves to her left but fails to cut it off.
This one comes slowly off the surface. Flighted and outside off, shorter in length, Lanning doesn't time her square cut. It rolls wide of the keeper and she looks for a run. Sent back by Rachael.
Uses her feet and nudges a full ball to long on for a single.
Flatter and shorter outside off, forced off the back foot through point for a run.
Mishit! Full and flighted outside off, Lanning reaches out for the drive but it takes the inner half and runs past the stumps and the keeper. The ball rolls to short fine leg.
Helps it off her pads through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Right from the middle of the bat this time. Full and flighted on middle, Haynes shimmies down the track and chips it over the bowler's head. It's towards the safest part of the ground and rushes past the fence.
Pushed to the cover region by the batter. They pick up a single. 59 needed more off 42 balls.

Yet another mishit, it seems! Floated full ball on middle, Haynes skips down the track and lofts it over the bowler's head. Doesn't get her shot entirely from the middle of the bat and hence it drops behind the mid on fielder. Two more added to the total.

DROPPED! This could prove to be very costly for Sri Lanka! Flighted and full ball on middle, Rachael dances down the track for a big shot but is not entirely to the pitch of the ball. She still goes on with her shot and hits it aerially towards mid on where the fielder attempts to catch it over her head but fluffs. The ball travels behind and the batters collect a couple. 50-run stand comes up!
Flighted and on off, it's pushed with an angled bat to point for a single.
Drags her length short and on middle, Rachael rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a run.
Shorter and around off, it's cut through point for a single.
Very full and on off, Lanning strokes it down to long off and retains strike. The match is slipping away now from Sri Lanka after a bright start. They need to break this partnership.
Mishit! Shortish and outside off, Lanning goes deep inside the crease for pull but is a shade early into it. Finds the fielder in front of square leg.
Possibly a slider on the shorter side around off, Haynes moves back and hits it towards mid-wicket for one.
This is too easy. Full and flighted on off. Meg forces it to long off for one.
Beaten! Short and wide outside off, Lanning attempts to cut but misses.
On one bounce to long on! Tossed up ball landing full around off, Rachael jumps down the track and pumps it over mid on. It drops in front of long on and they take a single.
Uses her feet again and drives a full ball to long off. A single to complete a 7-run over. 71 needed off 54 balls.
Serves it short and wide outside off, Lanning easily cuts it through point for a single.
Finds the gap this time by driving the ball a little straighter. She sends it to long off by coming down the track and takes a single.
Yet another good looking drive by Rachael but she fails to beat the cover fielder again.
Full and flighted on off, Rachael drives but finds the cover fielder.

FOUR! Well swept! Full and flighted around middle and leg, Haynes takes the spin into account and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary. The stand has moved to 39 runs and it's taking the match away from the Islanders.
Steps down the track and works it with the spin to deep mid-wicket for a single. 78 needed more at the halfway stage!
Quicker, flatter and shorter outside off, Haynes tries to cut but misses.
Fullish and around leg, Haynes sweeps but finds short fine leg.

Lanning sweeps the ball with so much conviction. Goes down on her one knee and fetches a full ball from outside off, she then keeps her sweep shot all along the ground and sends it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Turns it off her pads to the leg side, picks the gap and collects a single.
Wide! Sprays a full ball well down the leg side, Haynes tries sweeping but misses.

INSIDE EDGE! The decision is overturned. Good use of the technology. Dilhari serves a fuller length ball around off and it skids on after landing. Haynes draws forward to play it across the line but misses. It strikes her on the front pad, they appeal and the umpire raises his finger after thinking for a while. Straightaway Rachael takes the DRS and the replays find a big inside edge.
Rachael Haynes is adjudged lbw. She walks up to her skipper and has also taken the DRS. Only an inside edge can save her...
Flatter on off, Rachael hangs back and forces it through covers for one. 9 from the over, the RRR is 7.45!
Tossed up ball on off, driven off the front foot but straight to the fielder at covers.
Fullish and on off, again it's been driven with ease through covers. One more added to the total.
Superbly driven on this occasion. Kumari has struggled so far with her lengths. This one is a little too full and is stroked to sweeper cover for a run.
Nicely done and a good running between the wickets as well. Haynes nudges it off her pads to backward square leg and scampers back for the second run. Soft hands.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Shorter delivery, just outside off, Haynes goes deep inside the crease to make room and then whacks it through backward point for a boundary.
Sugandika Kumari is on.
Very full and on off, it's been driven nicely in front of square on the off side for a run. This stand is settling down now and Sri Lanka need to strike quickly. 91 needed off 72 balls.
Floated ball, full and close to off, Rachael is forward as he blocks it back in the direction of the bowler.
Presses forward to a full ball and drives it through covers for one.

Beaten! Short and wide outside off, Lanning opts to play the square cut but there is extra bounce and it beats her bat. Hang on, Snicko shows some spike. Interesting, there wasn't much appeal from the Lankans.
Lovely shot! Lanning goes down on one knee and sweeps it in front of square leg for a couple of runs.
Short and wide outside off, Meg chops her attempted cut to point.
Wide! Loopy delivery, full and way wide outside off, Lanning allows it through.
Kavisha Dilhari is into the attack.
Fullish and on middle, it's pushed back to the bowler.
Knocks a full ball down through mid on for a run.
FOUR! Slapped away. Short and wide outside off, Lanning latches onto it and slaps it through the gap between backward point and short third man.

NOT OUT! Lanning survives with a full length dive. Coming to the delivery, it's a short delivery outside off with some hint of movement in the air. Haynes cracks it off his back foot to point where the fielder fumbles and hence the batters decide to cross. The throw comes to the keeper who takes the bails off. It's referred upstairs and the replays find Meg safe. Direct hit would have been curtains for the Aussie skipper.
Shout for a run out! It has been referred upstairs...
Loopy full ball around off, it's driven past the diving cover fielder for a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, it's punched down to long on for a run.
On middle, Haynes flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Lanning punches it through mid off for a single.
Floated delivery on middle, Lanning flicks it towards the leg side.
Loopy delivery on off, Lanning defends it off the front foot.
Flighted delivery on middle, Haynes flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Haynes comes down the track and keeps it out.
Length delivery on off, the skipper drives it towards mid off.
Full again and outside off, Lanning drives it to covers.
Full delivery on off, Lanning drives it to covers.
On a good length on off, Lanning defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Nicely played! Length delivery on off, Lanning guides it very fine towards third man for a boundary.
Full delivery on off, Haynes drives it through covers for a single.

NOT OUT! There is no edge! Flighted delivery outside off, Lanning looks to cut but misses it. The keeper appeals for caught behind but the umpire shakes his head. Sri Lanka take the review. Ultra Edge detects no edge on that one.
An appeal for a caught behind! Sri Lanka have taken the review.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Haynes flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Haynes looks to sweep but gets hit on the pads.
Rachael Haynes is the next batter in.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Haynes defends it off the back foot.

OUT! STUMPED! Australia are in deep trouble here! Floated delivery just outside off, Mooney comes down the track and looks to go big but misses it. It goes towards the keeper where Anushka Sanjeewani takes the bails off in a flash.
Tossed up delivery on off, Mooney punches it to point.
Full delivery on off, Lanning drives it through covers. The batsmen pick up a couple. Excellent over from Prabodhani.
Meg Lanning, the skipper, is the new batter in.
OUT! TIMBER! Prabodhani bowls it on a good length on off, it comes back in, Gardner looks to defend but misses it completely and gets bowled.
Good length delivery on middle, Gardner keeps it out.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Gardner looks to cut but misses it.
Full toss on off, Gardner drives it towards mid off.
On a good length on off, Gardner defends it off the back foot.
Floated delivery on middle, Mooney flicks it to mid-wicket.
Floated delivery on off, Mooney defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Mooney defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Nicely played! Loopy delivery on off, Mooney comes down the track and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Full delivery on off, Gardner drives it through mid off for a run.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Mooney flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Shashikala Siriwardene to bowl from the other end.
Length delivery on off, Mooney guides it towards third man for a single.
Full again on middle, Mooney flicks it to mid-wicket.
Full again on middle, Gardner flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Gardner drives it towards mid on.
Ashleigh Gardner is the next batter in.
OUT! BOWLED! Excellent ball from Prabodhani! On a good length on middle, Healy looks to defend but misses it due to the inswing on this one and gets bowled.
On a good length on middle, Healy pushes it back towards the bowler.

We are back for the chase. The Sri Lankan players are out in the middle. Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney will open the batting for the hosts. Udeshika Prabodhani will start the proceedings for Sri Lanka.
